products.name: INTA Desktop
products.summary: Install the technician workspace or extract the portable app. The MSI uses the self-signed INTA Desktop Preview certificate, so Windows can show an unknown-publisher warning.
products.tested: The release reports installed and portable manifest verification and installed Windows UI checks.

products.name: INTA Mobile
products.summary: Offline repair drafts, work orders, timers, invoices and encrypted diagnostics import. This APK does not control Desktop or Rescue live.
products.tested: The release reports Android 16 emulator acceptance and APK v2/v3 signature verification; physical phone acceptance is not established here.

products.name: INTA Rescue Recovery
products.summary: Recovery only: runs offline for disk inspection, imaging and file recovery. No antivirus scanner or live Mobile control.
products.requirements: Media Creator runs on Windows or Linux with Python 3.11+ and Tk.
products.tested: The release reports BIOS, UEFI, OVMF Secure Boot with enrolled keys and Ventoy VM boots, and offline recovery with the synthetic source unchanged. Physical systems and USB controllers remain untested.
